prompt: Create a new 'Vendor Credit' form page for the AccaBiz ERP. It should have fields for vendor selection, credit amount, date, reference number, notes, and line items table. Use the DetailPanel pattern for viewing/editing.

assertions.evidence: Component imports and uses DetailPanel from @/components/DetailPanel

assertions.text: Has form fields for vendor, credit amount, date, reference, notes, and line items
assertions.evidence: getCreateForm includes all required fields with proper state management

assertions.text: Line items table with add/remove functionality
Uses proper button styling (btn classes or standard patterns)
assertions.evidence: Buttons use consistent styling with bg-blue-600, rounded-xl, font-bold

assertions.text: Status badge display with proper styling
